ai.title: The AI jobs shock: Why reskilling could become unavoidable by 2030, says report
ai.description: Artificial intelligence is set to reshape the workplace by automating tasks, reducing headcount in some white-collar roles and changing the skills employers demand. The IEEE Megatrends 2030 report warns that reskilling could become unavoidable as AI adoption accelerates across industries.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能就业冲击：报告称，为什么到2030年重新技能可能变得不可避免
ai.description_cn: 人工智能将通过任务自动化、减少一些白领职位的人数以及改变雇主需求的技能来重塑工作场所。《IEEE Megatrends 2030》报告警告称，随着人工智能在各个行业加速采用，重新培训可能变得不可避免。

ai.title: Warsh raises stakes for Fed's next meeting and other takeaways from Jackson Hole conference
ai.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh provided his most detailed insights yet on how he views the central bank's fight against inflation in a high-profile speech an at annual economic conference in Jackson Hole Friday. In saying that he hasn't seen evidence that inflation is cooling, Warsh put more pressure on the Fed to increase interest rates when it next meets in mid-September. It's unclear if the Fed does hike short-term rates soon whether long-term rates would follow and lead to higher borrowing costs for consumers. Warsh also reiterated his belief that artificial intelligence has the ability to make the economy more efficient.
ai.title_cn: 沃什为美联储下次会议和杰克逊霍尔会议的其他要点加大赌注
ai.description_cn: 美联储主席凯文·沃什周五在杰克逊霍尔举行的年度经济会议上发表了一次高调演讲，就他如何看待央行抗击通胀的斗争提供了迄今为止最详细的见解。沃什表示，他还没有看到通胀正在降温的证据，并向美联储施加了更大的压力，要求其在9月中旬下次会议上加息。目前尚不清楚美联储是否会很快上调短期利率，长期利率是否会随之上调并导致消费者借贷成本上升。沃什还重申了他的信念，即人工智能有能力提高经济效率。
